act_thesis: Pattern becomes systemic. Disturbances cross neighbourhoods and systems faster than the city can close them out; civic coordination, not spectacle, carries the failure (E40–E41). Care helps people without controlling the phenomenon (E43). The rebound breaks Lucien's model and turns shared burden into usable behaviour (E45). After the Wide Quiet and the Square's human memory, the trio arrive together at a predicted quiet pulse and Seraphine carries one, at bodily cost: understanding without control. The city knows something is happening; nobody knows enough.

act_success_criteria: E38 establishes a changed baseline, not an isolated incident; "hum" stays ambiguous (source: v4.1b E38)
E38–E41 use distinct material failure chains (routes, dispatch, care capacity), not repeated unnamed surges (source: evidence ledger (E38–41 row); census cards B01-40A/B01-40B)
E39 is the strongest synthesis; the remote item is suggestive, not confirmatory (source: v4.1b E39)
E40: cohesion breaks through fear, conflicting information and contagion, never mind control; officials unnamed unless earned (source: v4.1b E40)
E41 makes aftermath human before any solution; E42 has nothing supernatural in it (source: v4.1b E41–E42)
The wonder episode (label E44, read first) stays unverified wonder: no mechanic, no danger, no report (source: v4.1b E44; evidence-ledger item E7)
The grounding episode (label E43): "care succeeding is not control succeeding" (source: v4.1b E43)

E45 meets its causal card: Lucien's collapse is point-of-view only, against a negative instrument check; Seraphine anchors him; the narrator never links the practice to the rebound; inquiry widens, certainty does not (source: CC §4; v4.1b E45; census card B01-45B)
E45 → E46 → E47 → E48 run with no supplement; E46 is not compressed, has no comedy and is not fully explained (source: v4.1b E46, §7)
E47: the Square's memory is human (routines, memorial habits, stories); the model is systemic, not global and not controllable, and points to a narrow window (source: v4.1b E47)

E48 meets its causal card: they arrive together by shared prediction; one stranger, not a child, is steadied; the whole Square is declined; the cost is bodily; the stranger walks out whole; a positive, quiet, independently checkable observation (source: VAA §4; D6; M03; CC §5)

Book-end state: the system is patterned; the city knows something is happening; nobody knows enough. Global extent unconfirmed; vocabulary fragmented (B02 owns pulse) (source: v4.1b E48, §9; VAA §1 E03)
S06 comes after the narrative close: the same room, incompatible stories, no reveal, no cliffhanger (source: v4.1b S06)
Every item of v4.1b's B01 → B02 handoff holds (source: v4.1b §9 and its handoff additions)
